verdict.rationale: TypeSafe's docs include a self-serve quickstart. It starts in the Playground (log in, paste state, add a Noul question) and then walks through the first API call with the SDKs. Install commands are documented for Python (`uv add typesafe-sdk`) and JavaScript (`npm install @typesafe-ai/sdk`), and the models page has cURL/Python/JavaScript examples. One community user describes an 'extremely low barrier to entry'. missing for 10: verbatim runnable quickstart code for the first call shown in the evidence, an explicit time-to-first-call claim, independent hands-on corroboration of the quickstart flow itself, and language coverage beyond Python/JS/cURL.

support.subject: As a developer, a quickstart takes me from zero to a first successful API call in minutes, with runnable code in my language
